ABSORB_BACKTICK.description: Look-alike closer (backtick, ~84% of real slips): the next argument is swallowed

ABSORB_FIRST_ARG.description: Look-alike closer on the first argument: the rest becomes junk keys

TRUNCATED_CALL.description: Generation cut by max_tokens inside a string: a partial call must not be executed

PY_LITERAL.description: Python literal spelling (True) instead of true

STRAY_DELIM_AFTER_NUMBER.description: Bare number followed by a stray delimiter (real slip: start_line:38<|"|>)

LAST_ARG_CLOSER.description: E closer_slip, last argument: look-alike closer right before }<tool_call|>

KEY_RESTART.description: E key_restart: closer, comma, newline+indent, the SAME key and a real opener

KEY_DRIFT_HALF_QUOTE.description: E key_drift: JSON quote on the key side (start_line":451)

OPENER_EQUALS_JSON.description: E opener_drift: separator '=' and a JSON string

OPENER_JSON_SPACE.description: E opener_drift: ': ' + JSON string with escapes (write_file content)

OPENER_BARE.description: E opener_drift: bare (unquoted) code as a value

UNCLOSED_CALL.description: E unparsed_call: complete arguments but no <tool_call|>

HANG_NESTED_BRACKET.description: Unbalanced ']' inside a string in a nested array

CALL_INJECTION_IN_STRING.description: A string that contains a complete call: parsers that cut at <tool_call|> emit an extra call

NULL_FOR_STRING_PARAM.description: null for a string-typed parameter (the template renders None as null)

FLOAT_INTEGRAL.description: Integral float 1.0 for a number parameter

FLOAT_EXPONENT.description: Float printed by Python str() with an exponent (1e+20)

STRING_LOOKS_NUMERIC.description: A <|"|>-delimited string that looks like a number, for an integer parameter

WHITESPACE_L1.description: Insignificant whitespace between tokens (valid L1, non-canonical)

SPECIAL_KEY.description: Bare key with a non-identifier character

QUADRATIC_CODE_PAYLOAD.description: 1000-line code string with commas/brackets (26 KB): parse time

LAUNDERED_SLIP_HISTORY.description: History re-render of a real absorbed slip: well-formed text carrying the corruption

NONREPRESENTABLE_HISTORY.description: History re-render of a slip whose junk key cannot be rendered bare

ABSORB.description: look-alike closer: next argument swallowed (synthetic + real slips)

ABSORB_REAL.description: real slips only (exact logged prefix + recovered/sampled old_string)

TRUNCATED.description: max_tokens-truncated call returned as a (partial) call

JSON_DIALECT.description: JSON-style string values / quoted keys kept with their quotes

NONL1_ACCEPTED.description: other ill-formed input accepted without any signal (paren opener, missing brace/close, trailing comma, duplicate key, bare string)

HANG.description: per-case timeout (5 s; 15 s streaming) on any input

EXCEPTION.description: uncaught exception escaping the parser (any input)

CTRL_IN_STRING.description: valid call whose string values contain control tokens: truncated / split / token deleted

NESTED_BRACKET.description: valid call with '[' or ']' inside strings of nested arrays

TYPE_DRIFT.description: valid call returned with a scalar of another type (null->'null', 1.0->1, 1e+20->str, '42'->42, ...)

VALID_CORRUPTED.description: valid call returned silently wrong (any silent class except type drift)

NAME.description: valid call with '-' or '.' in the function name returned without / with a wrong name

E:closer_slip.description: workstream-E class closer_slip (family P): silently wrong

E:key_restart.description: workstream-E class key_restart (family P): silently wrong

E:opener_drift.description: workstream-E class opener_drift (family P): silently wrong

E:key_drift.description: workstream-E class key_drift (family P): silently wrong

E:unparsed_call.description: workstream-E class unparsed_call (family P): silently wrong
